info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Loan Application By Collateral Id-spec
info.description: The Collateral Management API enables seamless updates to loan applications associated with specific collateral identifiers. This functionality is essential for financial institutions managing dynamic loan portfolios, allowing them to reflect changes in collateral status or details promptly. Typical consumers include loan officers and financial analysts who require real-time data synchronization to make informed decisions. By updating loan applications through this API, users can ensure their records are accurate and up-to-date, enhancing operational efficiency.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update collateral details associated with a specific loan application identified by a unique resource ID. Ensure that all required details are provided in the request to successfully update the collateral information.

200.description: The collateral has been successfully updated.
